concepts.label: fabric-attachment
concepts.gloss: A fabric attachment binding an access-port on a leaf-switch to a VLAN that is carried across the fabric.

concepts.label: fabric-vlan
concepts.gloss: An L2-domain (VLAN) defined on a leaf-switch, representing a broadcast domain associated with that leaf.

concepts.label: leaf-switch
concepts.gloss: A leaf-switch node (ToR) that functions as an edge device in the fabric and interconnects to spine switches.

concepts.label: fabric-mtu
concepts.gloss: The underlay MTU value configured for a leaf, defining the maximum frame size for underlay traffic.

concepts.label: svi-gateway
concepts.gloss: An L3 gateway (SVI) that serves as the gateway for a specific VLAN.

concepts.label: spine-switch
concepts.gloss: A spine-switch node (fabric core) that interconnects leaf switches in the fabric.

concepts.label: availability-zone
concepts.gloss: A fault-domain (availability zone) that spans multiple leaf switches in the fabric.

concepts.label: lattice-tag-3
concepts.gloss: An opaque leaf-attached vendor attribute representing a proprietary lattice tag.
